_readme: Cable / bar product data for cable_schedule.py. Fmin = minimum breaking force F_min [kN] (EN 12385-2); ke = termination loss factor (EN 1993-1-11 Table 6.3) unless 'ke_included' (Fmin is then already the characteristic breaking load of the assembly); A = metallic area [mm2]; E = modulus on metallic area [kN/mm2]; EA_MN = published axial stiffness; mass_kg_m; Fk = 0.2 % proof / yield force (bars); gammaR_ETA = partial factor used by the product ETA when larger than the project γR; *_pub = published design values kept for validation. status: 'V: ...' = value read in the cited public datasheet/ETA (URL in 'source'); 'U: ...' = estimate/computed. ALWAYS replace with the supplier's current datasheet / ETA for design.
